arabicText:
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ ٱلصِّدِّيقَةِ فَاطِمَةَ ٱلزَّكِيَّةِ
حَبِيبَةِ حَبِيبِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ
englishText:
O Allah, (please) send blessings upon the veracious and immaculate lady Fatimah
the most beloved of Your beloved and Prophet
of Your beloved ones and Your chosen ones,
and chosen her from among all the women of the worlds (of all times).

arabicText: اَللَّهُمَّ كُنِ ٱلطَّالِبَ لَهَا مِمَّنْ ظَلَمَهَا
englishText: O Allah, be her representative against those who wronged her
Be, O Allah, the One Who shall revenge upon those who shed the blood of her descendants.

arabicText: اَللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا جَعَلْتَهَا أُمَّ أَئِمَّةِ ٱلْهُدَىٰ
englishText: O Allah, just as You have chosen her to be the mother of the Leaders of Guidance,
the wife of the Bearer of the Pennon,
and the most honored lady with the Highest Group,
so (please) do endow her and her mother
with such blessings that confer honor upon her father
Muhammad, Allah's blessings be upon him,
and delight the eyes of her offspring.
And (please) convey to them, at this very hour,
the most excellent greeting and salutation from me.

arabicText: لَعَنَ اللَّهُ قَاتِلَيْكِ وَضَارِبَيْكِ وَظَالِمَيْكِ وَغَاصِبِي حَقِّكِ،
englishText: "May Allah curse those who killed you, struck you, oppressed you, and usurped your rights,
